claims.claim: DWN has an open-source implementation that converts trained models to synthesizable Verilog for FPGA deployment.
claims.quote: Turn trained differentiable weightless neural networks into pipelined, synthesizable Verilog for FPGA deployment.

claims.claim: DWN compares favorably against leading approaches on tabular datasets with higher average rank.
claims.quote: DWNs also compare favorably against leading approaches for tabular datasets, with higher average rank.

claims.claim: PolyLUT demonstrates effectiveness on network intrusion detection, a tabular data task.
claims.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in three tasks: network intrusion detection, jet identification at the CERN Large Hadron Collider, and handwritten digit recognition using the MNIST dataset.

claims.claim: ULEEN is compared against BNNs using the four MLPerf Tiny datasets and MNIST.
claims.quote: We compare ULEEN against BNNs in software and hardware using the four MLPerf Tiny datasets and MNIST.

claims.claim: LogicNets, PolyLUT, and PolyLUT-Add are identified as existing LUT-DNN approaches that rely on fixed sparsity masks.
claims.quote: existing LUT-DNN approaches (e.g., LogicNets, PolyLUT, PolyLUT-Add, and NeuraLUT) that rely on fixed sparsity masks.

open_questions: No source reports CPU inference cost for any of the listed families compared with small MLPs.
BTHOWeN is not mentioned in any source.
Open implementations for WiSARD, ULEEN, LogicNets, and PolyLUT are not described in these sources.
Results on text data are not reported for any family in these sources.
